desc:
FRUIT FLAVORED SNACKS: Variety Pack features your favorite Fruit Flavored Snacks - Fruit Roll-Ups, Fruit by the Foot, and Gushers; With wild flavors and colors, the possibilities for fun are endless.

FUN KIDS SNACK: These snack pouches are the perfect treat to include in a packed school lunch box.

GLUTEN FREE: Tasty gummy treats are made without gluten and a good source of vitamin C; Ideal pantry staples.

ON THE GO SNACK: These fruit flavored snacks and fruit flavored strips are a quick and easy go-to; Treats every member of the family can enjoy.

CONTAINS: One 10.2 oz Variety Pack of Fruit Roll-Ups, Fruit by the Foot, and Gushers Fruit Flavored Snacks; 16 count.
features:
Features

Three Snack Types in One Pack

Includes Fruit Roll-Ups, Fruit by the Foot, and Gushers — all offering different textures and formats for variety and fun.

Gluten-Free & Gelatin-Free

Made without gluten or gelatin, making them suitable for a wider range of dietary needs.

Good Source of Vitamin C

Each serving is fortified with vitamin C, contributing to daily nutrient needs.

Individually Wrapped for Convenience

Perfect for lunchboxes, backpacks, party favors, or snack drawers.

Kid-Friendly Flavors & Colors

Bold, fruity flavors and bright colors make them appealing and exciting for kids (and nostalgic adults).

Benefits

Fun, Interactive Snacking

From unrolling long strips to biting into juicy Gushers, these snacks bring playfulness to snack time.

Portable and Mess-Free

Easy to grab and go—great for travel, picnics, or school.

Variety Keeps It Interesting

Three different snack styles in one box keep snack time fresh and exciting.

Nutrient Boost with Vitamin C

Provides a small vitamin C boost, unlike traditional candy.

Suitable for Diverse Diets

With no gelatin, no gluten, and no artificial flavors, it accommodates many dietary preferences.
ingredients: Fruit Roll-Ups Ingredients: Corn Syrup, Sugar, Pear Puree, Maltodextrin, Palm and/or Palm Kernel Oil. Contains 2% or less of: Citric Acid, Sodium Citrate, Monoglycerides, Fruit Pectin, Malic Acid, Vitamin C (ascorbic acid), Natural Flavor, Color (red 40, yellows 5 & 6, blue 1). Fruit By The Foot Ingredients: Sugar, Maltodextrin, Corn Syrup, Pear Puree, Palm and/or Palm Kernel Oil. Contains 2% or less of: Citric Acid, Carrageenan, Monoglycerides, Sodium Citrate, Malic Acid, Xanthan Gum, Vitamin C (ascorbic acid), Locust Bean Gum, Potassium Citrate, Color (red 40, yellow 6, and blue 1), Natural Flavor. Gushers Ingredients: Corn Syrup, Sugar, Pear Puree, Modified Corn Starch, Fructose, Maltodextrin, Palm Oil. Contains 2% or less of: Cottonseed Oil, Glycerin, Grape Juice Concentrate, Citric Acid, Carrageenan, Monoglycerides, Sodium Citrate, Malic Acid, Vitamin C (ascorbic acid), Potassium Citrate, Agar-Agar, Natural and Artificial Flavor, Xanthan Gum, Color (red 40, blue 1, yellows 5 & 6).
